titulo: Waiting while they find the keys
caption:
Waiting while they find the keys

Waiting while they find the keys.

Being rushed makes a search slower, because pressure narrows attention.

For whoever says no rush at the door.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right looking down. The blue one pats around with a bubble that says keys?, then wallet?, then phone? while it trembles a little. The black one waits calmly with a bubble that says no rush. At last the blue one looks up with happy eyes and a bubble that says found! and both pulse. The text stays: me waiting while they find their keys. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
